files.content: import * as React from 'react' import { Bell } from '@phosphor-icons/react' import { IconTile } from '@/components/ui/icon-tile' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type Hue, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface NotificationCardProps { count: number label: string latestText: string icon?: React.ReactNode iconHue?: Hue tone?: TileTone onClick?: () => void } export function NotificationCard({ count, label, latestText, icon, iconHue = 'periwinkle', tone = 'white', onClick, }: NotificationCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] return ( {icon ?? } {count} {label} {latestText} ) }
